Estimated intake by item:
- **Cornflakes:** about 30 g, all eaten (110 kcal).
- **Milk:** the bottle held about 250 ml. Most of it went into the cereal; about 30 ml is left in the bottle and about 50 ml in the bowl, so roughly 170 ml was consumed (about 105 kcal).
- **Coffee latte:** about 300 ml, all eaten (about 120 kcal).
- **Peaches:** about 80 g, eaten (about 45 kcal).
- **Eggs:** 2 fried eggs, about 100 g, eaten (about 180 kcal).
- **Water:** about 150 ml of the 250 ml was drunk. It is counted in mass but adds no calories.

The calorie total is 110 + 105 + 120 + 45 + 180 = 560 kcal. The food mass excluding water is 30 + 175 + 300 + 80 + 100 = 685 g. Including the water gives about 835 g. I report 685 g, food only.
